title: A helper that calls a helper
prompt: The robot beeps twice, and both beeps come from one call in `run`. The output is beep, beep.
hints: beep prints "beep"; double_beep calls beep twice; run calls double_beep once. Any function can call any other function, not just run.
double_beep is `func double_beep():` with `beep()` written twice inside it.
run then only needs one line: `double_beep()`.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
